Profile Yellow dock, the root of Rumex crispus (Polygonaceae) has lax- ative and choleretic properties. It is used for constipation, jaun- dice, and chronic skin disorders. Homoeopathy. Yellow Dock has been used in homoeopathic medicines under the following names: Rumex; Rumex crispus; Rumex c.
